title: The Road Bike Everybody Should Own in 2024! Giant Defy Advanced 1 review

takeaways.text: The geometry is more relaxed than a race bike but lower at the front than a Roubaix or Domane; 32 mm tires come fitted.
The Advanced frame is the same layup and claimed 860 g as the mid-range Advanced Pro; only the fork is a lower grade, still full carbon including the steerer, with a two-piece stem and bar.
His Advanced 1 test bike weighed 8.6 kg; the 105 Di2 11–36 gearing got him over a long, very steep sportive.
A long rear centre and slacker head angle make it calm on rough, fast roads; comfort is not quite at Roubaix level but well above a race bike, and he felt fresher late in long rides.

disclosure: How the test bike was supplied is not stated. The Defy Advanced 1 shares the Advanced frame and fork grade with the candidate's Advanced 2; components differ.
summary: A ride review of the 2024 Giant Defy Advanced 1 (105 Di2) after several weeks and a hilly sportive.
